searchText: to do this we would have to change the order of references when using `anyOf` as the explorer will pick the first entry as use that as example, I think it's not a bad idea though Perhaps listing them with the most current fork first would be a good practice to start. also did a refactoring which should help a bit https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/497 (the diff got out of hand though 😅 ) This mostly addresses the confusion around what attestation type is used, looks like it was not always clear that `Attestation` was specifically `Phase0.Attestation` wasn't https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/#/Builder/getNextWithdrawals replaced in practice by the events API? by the time Nimbus implemented I only heard that the MEV people didn't care anymore deprecate, maybe, if so we don't even have that one implemented.. nobody complained so far deprecate, see if anyone complains during electra, remove in fulu if not? they definitely do prefer the events as far as I know sure, I don't have good rationale for removing it other than it's probably not widely used but Michael and Paul can maybe chime in, you wanna put up the PR? I'll make the PR yeah It has no use case I've ever seen outside the backend of a MEV system, but maybe someone knows more and if people do use it, ok https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/498
